about_the_game:
The Monster Con is back in town! Put on your favorite cosplay and grab your autograph book, because you’re going back to the craziest convention ever… with 2 brand new playable characters to choose from!

  • Damien is here to represent hotheads everywhere. The Prince of Hell might hide a soft side, but he still has his usual stab-loving and arson-obsessed outer self. Wanna wreak some havoc and watch the world burn while looking fabulous? Then this demon was made for you.
  • But what if you're less of a spicy red baby and more of a suave cool cat? We have you covered too! Meet Valerie, your favorite punk shopkeeper turned playable character. She's an expert con artist whose idea of fun is stealing from the rich to give it to herself.

Get ready to nerd out with hot monsters... and be a hot, nerdy monster yourself!

content_descriptors.notes: Use of mature language in a humorous way.
